build_basis: Assembled items bought in 25%+ of the won games, by median minute: ward_dispenser 98% (3), magic_wand 84% (4), ring_of_basilius 100% (7), arcane_boots 100% (11), pavise 22% (19), glimmer_cape 77% (19), solar_crest 21% (22), aghanims_shard 47% (23), ghost 24% (25), staff_of_wizardry 57% (26), force_staff 22% (27), point_booster 37% (27), ogre_axe 35% (28), blade_of_alacrity 29% (31), ultimate_scepter 21% (32). Reviewed: dropped Ring of Basilius, Pavise/Solar Crest (21-22%), Ghost Scepter (24%), Force Staff (22%) and the Aghanim's Scepter parts (Staff of Wizardry, Point Booster, Ogre Axe, Blade of Alacrity), keeping the Scepter itself (21% whole at 32 min). STRATZ pos5 (3400 games): Glimmer Cape 18 min (52%), the same; pos4 has no build rows.
